title: Tour 1 — Session Context & Access Import
description: Explore the left Session Context bar (replacing the old Data Centre) and see how .accdb and .mdb projects import into VPro project files.

steps.title: Persistent Session Context Bar
steps.body: Replaces the floating VPro 64 Data Centre. Your active Project, Site Unit, Hierarchy, and Lump tables stay visible in one place and protected against accidental overwrites.

steps.title: Project Admin & Access .accdb/.mdb Import
steps.body: Create projects, run 3-way merges, clean duplicate vegetation records, or import legacy Access projects with an import quarantine log for any unmatched rows.

steps.title: Open Scientific Interchange Hub
steps.body: Exchange data cleanly with VENUS 5.0 XML, TurboVeg 3, GeoPackage (BC Albers EPSG:3005), CSV matrices, and R .rds.

title: Tour 2 — Fast FS882 Card & Datasheet Entry
description: Navigate FS882, Two-Page, and SIVI forms, live LMH25 field checks, extended shrub layers, and the multi-plot 9-table Datasheet.

steps.title: FS882 Ecological Field Card
steps.body: Enter Site, Soil, and Vegetation strata with Enter-key grid navigation, percent cover from 0 to under 100% (e.g. 99.9%), and F1 LMH25 help on any field.

steps.title: Multi-Plot 9-Table Datasheet
steps.body: Review and batch-edit Site Environment, Vegetation, Humus, Mineral Soil, Audit, and Site Unit tables with clipboard paste and automatic audit history.

title: Tour 3 — Classification Explorer & Taxon Lumping
description: Manage Site Unit assignments, 12-level Hierarchies with tilde (~) breakpoints, and repeatable species lumping tables.

steps.title: Dual-Pane Site Unit & Hierarchy Explorer
steps.body: Assign plots across Site Units, synchronize assignments between Site Units and plot records, and organize 12-level classification trees with tilde (~) report breakpoints.

steps.title: Taxon Lumping & Presets
steps.body: Build repeatable species lumping tables for regional synthesis without altering your original field plot codes.

title: Tour 4 — 3D Map, BEC Diagnostics & Reports
description: Verify BGC v13 plot locations on the offline 3D Map, run live BEC Differential Synthesis, and export Excel workbooks or Quarto guides.

steps.title: Offline 3D Map & Spatial QA
steps.body: Explore provincial BGC v13 and Ecosection layers offline, check plot coordinates against regional boundaries, and select plots directly into Site Units.

steps.title: Live BEC Differential & Pairwise Synthesis
steps.body: Inspect Presence Class, Differential Value (d1–d3, dd1–dd4), and Cramér similarity—results update immediately as plots move between units and export to a 4-sheet Excel workbook (.xlsx).

steps.title: R Companion: climr aSMR, Clustering & Quarto Guides
steps.body: Save downscaled climate normals in the plot climate cache, compare rSMR and aSMR edatopic grids, run candidate plot clustering, and publish Quarto Site Unit and BGC guides.
